description: Windows 11 Dynamic Island desktop overlay with media controls, notifications, tasks, focus tools, and customizable pages.
notes: The publisher builds this as a self-contained win-x64 app and packages the payload with Inno Setup. Scoop uses Inno Setup extraction and does not run the normal setup routine.
The publisher's release notes state that Windows 11 x64 is the tested platform. The app keeps settings under %APPDATA%\Island.
